Layered Wards.when: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
Layered Wards.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Soulsight.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot.
Soulsight.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re‑roll: ▪ One hit roll. ▪ One wound roll. ▪ One damage roll.

Vectored Engines.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit makes a fall‑back move.
Vectored Engines.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot. UNIQUE: ACROBATIC FATEFUL PERFORMANCE ACROBATIC KILLERS OF THE HARLEQUINS MASQUES STRIKE DETACHMENT RULES ACROBATIC ONSLAUGHT Trying to fight the Harlequins of the Laughing God is like battling bladed smoke. They flip and bound through the enemy ranks with contemptuous ease, springing across the heads and shoulders of dumbfounded combatants, sprinting across the hulls of war engines, all the while bearing down with murderous intent upon their true intended victims. While a friendly HARLEQUINS unit is making a charge move, that unit can move through enemy models. This detachment has the ACROBATIC tag and cannot be taken with another ACROBATIC detachment. ENHANCEMENTS A FOOT IN THE FUTURE Flowing like starlight across the field of battle, this warrior‑artiste leads their chorus in a dance whose speed peaks as they surge into the foe. TROUPE MASTER model only. This unit can re‑roll charge rolls. MISTWEAVE Employing their psychic powers of illusion and obfuscation, this Shadowseer can cause their comrades to vanish from the foe’s perceptions. SHADOWSEER model only. This unit has Infiltrators. WITH SPEED, SKILL AND MURDEROUS GRACE

Khaine’s Vengeance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**) is selected to Fall Back.
Khaine’s Vengeance.target: One **ASPECT WARRIORS** or **AVATAR OF KHAINE** unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Khaine’s Vengeance.effect: All models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle‑shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
Khaine’s Vengeance.lore: Embodying the rage of Khaine himself, these warriors press home their attack and strike down those cowards who seek to flee their fury.

Preternatural Precision.target: One **ASPECT WARRIORS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Preternatural Precision.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, select one of the following abilities, or select two of the following abilities if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem: **[IGNORES COVER]**, **[LETHAL HITS]**, **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected abilities.
Preternatural Precision.lore: Analysing their targets’ weaknesses with incredible skill, the Aeldari fire for lethal effect.

Skyborne Sanctuary.target: One unengaged **ASURYANI** unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase and one friendly **TRANSPORT** it is able to embark within.
Skyborne Sanctuary.effect: If your **ASURYANI** unit is wholly within 6” of that **TRANSPORT**, it can embark within it.
Skyborne Sanctuary.lore: The Aeldari excel in striking swiftly then leaping back into the safety of their skimming transports.

To Their Final Breath.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
To Their Final Breath.target: One **ASPECT WARRIORS** or **AVATAR OF KHAINE** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
To Their Final Breath.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
To Their Final Breath.lore: As champions and defenders of a dying race, these warriors fight furiously to the very end.

Warrior Focus.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Warrior Focus.target: One **ASPECT WARRIORS** or **AVATAR OF KHAINE** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Warrior Focus.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill, Weapon skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
Warrior Focus.lore: So absolute is the focus of these warriors in battle that nothing can distract them or stay their blows.

Cloak and Shadow.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Cloak and Shadow.target: One Aeldari Infantry unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker that you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Cloak and Shadow.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability and your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Into the Breach.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Anhrathe unit from your army destroyed one or more enemy units.
Into the Breach.effect: After your unit has resolved all of its shooting attacks, it can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

Lethal Ruse.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Aeldari unit from your army Falls Back.
Lethal Ruse.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If it is an Anhrathe unit, also select one enemy unit your unit was within Engagement Range of at the start of the phase, and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Outcast Ambush.target: One Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Outcast Ambush.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] and [RAPID FIRE 1] abilities, and until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

Pirates’ Due.target: One Aeldari unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Pirates’ Due.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re‑roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit has the Anhrathe keyword, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re‑roll the Wound roll instead.

FAQS Q: Can the Yncarne use the Inevitable Death ability during my opponent’s first turn? A: Yes. Q: After using the Torc of Morai-Heg Enhancement, if my opponent does not have the necessary CP available for the selected Stratagem, what happens? A: No CP are spent and that Stratagem’s effects are not resolved (but that Stratagem still counts as having been used this phase). Q: When using the Yncarne’s Ethereal Form ability, can I choose for it to regain fewer lost wounds than the D3 roll generated? A: No. Q: After using the Torc of Morai-Heg Enhancement, must my opponent continue to use the selected Stratagem at the increased cost if they have necessary CP available? A: Yes. Macabre Resilience.target: One **YNNARI INFANTRY** or **YNNARI MOUNTED** unit from your army (excluding **WRAITH CONSTRUCT** units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Macabre Resilience.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Macabre Resilience.lore: Such is the conviction and power of the Ynnari that sometimes even mortal wounds cannot slow them.

Pall of Dread.target: One **YNNARI** unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Pall of Dread.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Pall of Dread.lore: Even after they fall, the most fervent Ynnari leave a sinister sense of watchfulness in their wake like some invisible death shroud.

Parting the Veil.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Parting the Veil.target: One **YNNARI** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Parting the Veil.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Parting the Veil.lore: In the moment of transcendent glory, before the Ynnari give their essence to their god, they fight harder than ever to take the foe with them to death.

Soulsight.target: One **YNNARI** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Soulsight.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[LETHAL HITS]** and **[IGNORES COVER]** abilities
Soulsight.lore: Perceiving the flickering soulstuff of their foes, the Ynnari strike with ruthless precision.

Impeding Fire.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Impeding Fire.target: One Rangers, Shroud Runners or Starfang unit from your army.
Impeding Fire.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding Titanic units) visible to and within 36" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

No Prey Too Big.target: One Anhrathe, Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
No Prey Too Big.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

No Prey too Big.target: One **ANHRATHE**, **RANGERS** or **SHROUD RUNNERS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
No Prey too Big.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
No Prey too Big.lore: By accurately targeting weak points in anatomies and superstructures, the Anhrathe can bring down even the most resilient of foes.

Raiders’ Spoils.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Raiders’ Spoils.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

Raider’s Spoils.target: One **ANHRATHE** unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Raider’s Spoils.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
Raider’s Spoils.lore: Even as battle rages around them, the Eldritch Raiders prioritise the seizing of treasures above the destruction of their foes.

Ruthless Killers.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Ruthless Killers.target: One Corsair Voidscarred unit from your 1CP army that has not been selected to shoot or Fight this phase.
Ruthless Killers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Withdraw and Reinforce.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Withdraw and Reinforce.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Withdraw and Reinforce.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Though lightly motivated, possessing a wealth of skills, overcome greater and more numerous foes have the riches they sought. Deploying by of voidships, winged Skyreavers lead the an adequate defence. VETERANS OF THE VOID No two bands of Anhrathe warriors are identical. Each possesses a wealth of experience that a cunning commander can bring to bear upon the foe. Each time you add an Anhrathe unit to your army, it can be given up to one Corsair Enhancement (see right). Each Corsair Enhancement included in your army must be unique. COTERIE void in search of worthwhile targets, often operating in small armed and armoured, such forces are cunning and knowledge and experience. These attributes enable them to and ensure that, by the time the final blow is struck, they sleek and swift skimmers or leaping from the open hatches assault, striking at stunned opponents before they can mount the remainder of the Corsair force, making the most of the back, seize loot and plunder from under their noses and in the aftermath of a dazzling and destructive onslaught. CORSAIR ENHANCEMENTS  INFAMY (AURA) These infamous raiders are rightly feared, and use their reputation to their advantage with easily identifiable armour and insignia. Anhrathe unit only. While an enemy unit is within 3” of this unit, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit (to a minimum of 1). WEBWAY PATHSTONE This smooth token contains esoteric knowledge of local Webway spurs. When activated by psychic impulse, it projects a mental map of these routes into the minds of the bearer, enabling them to locate hidden gates, bypass their foes, and seize the treasures they seek. Anhrathe unit only. Models in this unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can use this ability. If it does, remove this unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. ARCHRAIDER A master of the lightning assault, this commander appears prescient in their ability to confound the foe. Anhrathe Character unit only. At the start of the battle, select one Character model in this unit. That model has the following ability: Lord of Deceit (Aura): Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that stratagem by 1CP. VOIDSTONE Seized from an alien tomb, this obsidian artefact seems to absorb light itself, offering the bearer and their unit a degree of protection against even the strongest attacks. Anhrathe Infantry unit only. Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Yriel’s Example.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Yriel’s Example.target: One Aeldari Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Yriel’s Example.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Deceptive Feint.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.
Deceptive Feint.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3". PATH OF THE STALKING SNIPERS AND RAPTORIAL HUNTERS UNLEASH DEATH DETACHMENT RULES FAR-REACHING DOOM With snipers’ instincts and psychoresponsive gunsights, the Asuryani frontier scouts can pierce almost any barrier to find the hearts of their targets. When a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit is selected to shoot, enemy units have +6" detection range until that friendly unit has shot. ENHANCEMENTS CAMOUFLAGED SNIPERS UPGRADE Aeldari Rangers rely upon fieldcraft and marksmanship to defeat their foes. They conceal themselves so expertly that even the act of firing upon the enemy does not reveal their precise location. RANGERS unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks do not prevent this unit from being hidden. ASSASSINS' EYE UPGRADE Having trodden the Path of the Outcast for so long that they risk becoming trapped upon it, these snipers have honed their talents until they can pinpoint eye lenses, armour seals and other weaknesses to fell the toughest foes. RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks that target a CHARACTER unit have +1 AP. OUTCAST AND FEAR FROM AFAR

Exit the Stage.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Exit the Stage.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Heroes’ Fall.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HARLEQUINS unit.
Heroes’ Fall.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: ▪ On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Exit the Stage.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Exit the Stage.target: One **HARLEQUINS** unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Exit the Stage.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Exit the Stage.lore: Players know when to fade back from the stage of war, ready to strike again when their moment comes.

Heroes’ Fall.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Heroes’ Fall.target: One **HARLEQUINS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Heroes’ Fall.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Heroes’ Fall.lore: Though they may be slain, this step of the saedath calls on the players to act out the demise of tragic heroes who take their enemies with them to death.

Mocking Flight.when: Your Movement phase, just after a **HARLEQUINS** unit from your army Falls Back.
Mocking Flight.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Mocking Flight.lore: *The Harlequins tumble away in mock terror and panic before spinning back into the fight with cruel laughter and redoubled fury.*

Staged Death.target: One **HARLEQUINS CHARACTER** model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Staged Death.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
Staged Death.lore: A feigned death and sudden, shocking return are as impactful as dismaying to the foe.

Blades of Asuryan.target: One **Dire AVENGERS** or **GUARDIANS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Blades of Asuryan.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[PISTOL]** ability.
Blades of Asuryan.lore: Asuryani martial teachings enable those wielding ranged weapons to employ them as close‑quarter implements of death as well.

Cost of Victory.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Cost of Victory.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. When doing so, return every destroyed **GUARDIANS** model to your unit.
Cost of Victory.lore: In so desperate and vital a fight, the Aeldari must accept casualties they would normally avoid and even send fresh warriors in to bolster the flagging ranks if it means victory.

Shield Nodes.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shield Nodes.target: One **DIRE AVENGERS** or **GUARDIANS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Shield Nodes.effect: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Shield Nodes.lore: Exploiting a spar of old Aeldari technology, these warriors engage the flickering ghosts of ancient defensive force fields.

Vaul’s Vengeance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a **DIRE AVENGERS** or **GUARDIANS** unit from your army
Vaul’s Vengeance.target: One **WAR WALKERS** unit from your army.
Vaul’s Vengeance.effect: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
Vaul’s Vengeance.lore: Swift and terrible vengeance comes for those who dare strike down the warriors of the Aeldari in the form of searing heavy weapons fire.

Warding Salvoes.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Warding Salvoes.target: One **DIRE AVENGERS** or **GUARDIANS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Warding Salvoes.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re‑roll the Wound roll.
Warding Salvoes.lore: Woe betide the foe that seeks to claim the holdings of armed and determined Asuryani.

Casting Back the Veil.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
Casting Back the Veil.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

Eldritch Suppression.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
Eldritch Suppression.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle‑shock roll, with ‑1 to that battle‑shock roll if a model in that enemy unit was destroyed by those attacks.

Nomads of the Hidden Way.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
Nomads of the Hidden Way.effect: ▪ Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6". ▪ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn. Friendly HARLEQUINS units have Stealth. This detachment has the ACROBATIC tag and cannot be taken with another ACROBATIC detachment. ENHANCEMENTS SHADOWFALL MASKS UPGRADE These nightmarish masks torment the enemy with a psychoresponsive bombardment laced through the murk generated by the wearers’ holofields. Fangs of the Brood.target: One Troupe unit from your army.
Fangs of the Brood.effect: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit’s Dance of Death ability, you can select three of the abilities for your unit to gain, instead of one.

Skyward Lunge.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Skyward Lunge.target: One Harlequins Vehicle or Harlequins Mounted unit from your army.
Skyward Lunge.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LANCE] ability. EXOTIC MUNITIONS In their travels through the void, these Anhrathe warriors have collected a bounty of esoteric ammunition. The most lethal of these munitions are toxic or acidic enough to fell monstrous foes or to burn through armour and servo-motors with frightening rapidity. Anhrathe unit only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ANTI‑MONSTER 5+] and [ANTI‑VEHICLE 5+] abilities. ADRENAL INFUSIONS Amongst the hauls taken by Aeldari Corsairs are many stimulants and elixirs, the most powerful of which enhance the already impressive grace and agility of the Aeldari physiology. It can do so even if other units have done so in the same phase, and doing so does not prevent other units from performing the same Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase.

Striking Stride.target: One Harlequins unit from your army.
Striking Stride.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Venomous Wrath.target: One Harlequins Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Venomous Wrath.effect: After your unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Weavers’ Coils.target: One Harlequins Mounted unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
Weavers’ Coils.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".

Weaving Stride.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Weaving Stride.target: One Harlequins Infantry unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Weaving Stride.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Presaged Rehearsal.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TROUPE unit is selected to fight.

Feigned Retreat.when: Your Movement phase, just after an **ASURYANI** unit from your army Falls Back.
Feigned Retreat.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Feigned Retreat.lore: What appears to be a full retreat one moment is revealed as the deceptive prelude to a devastating attack the next.

Lightning-fast Reactions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lightning-fast Reactions.target: One **ASURYANI** unit from your army (excluding **WRAITH CONSTRUCT** units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lightning-fast Reactions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Lightning-fast Reactions.lore: Processing events at incredible speed, these warriors easily evade attacks that would have slain any less celeritous combatants.

Skyborne Sanctuary.target: One unengaged **ASURYANI** unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase and one friendly **TRANSPORT** it is able to embark within.
Skyborne Sanctuary.effect: If your **ASURYANI** unit is wholly within 6” of that **TRANSPORT**, it can embark within it.
Skyborne Sanctuary.lore: The Aeldari excel in striking swiftly, then leaping back into the safety of their skimming transports.

Death From On High.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Death From On High.target: One **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield from Reserves this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Death From On High.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re‑roll the Wound roll.
Death From On High.lore: Streaking suddenly down from on high, the Aeldari strike like the fall of an executioner’s blade.

Focused Firepower.target: One **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Focused Firepower.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Focused Firepower.lore: Able to analyse and assess target data at incredible speeds, these Aeldari isolate the foe’s weak spot and pour all their fire into it as they hurtle past.

Spiralling Evasion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Spiralling Evasion.target: One **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Spiralling Evasion.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Spiralling Evasion.lore: None but the Aeldari could risk such breakneck and seemingly suicidal evasive manoeuvres to jink around incoming enemy fire.

Wind of Blades.target: One **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Wind of Blades.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
Wind of Blades.lore: Warriors such as these cannot be pinned down or held back. They hit and run at will, hammering the foe with constant fire and slashing blows.
